verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or tracking devices. They are designed solely to stimulate the immune system to produce antibodies.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple public health authorities, including the CDC, and independent fact-checkers have confirmed that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or tracking devices. The claim stems from misinterpretations of external packaging sensors and is entirely unfounded.
